card.name: Graj
card.tagline: Gwoka work rhythm miming manioc/cassava preparation.
card.profile: Graj (grage) is one of the seven gwoka base rhythms, a work rhythm linked to agricultural labor whose movements evoke the phases of grating manioc into cassava flour and field harvesting; it is generally slower, with the reprise marked, and is sometimes danced by women as a seductive dance. Played on the ka drums (two boula plus make) with chacha and responsorial Creole song, danced in the lawonn circle during lewoz gatherings (Wikipedia: Gwo ka; Loka Guadeloupe).
card.insight: Graj's choreography directly imitates the grating of manioc (grage manioc), making it one of the clearest examples of gwoka as embodied memory of plantation labor.
